paragraphs: SS8 Networks sells lawful intelligence software used to capture, deliver, visualize and analyze investigative data. Its Xcipio platform gives communication service providers passive and active lawful interception, with data handover, for any type of network, including 5G, so that they can meet regulatory requirements. Xcipio supports CALEA, ETSI and national-specific standards. It can run virtualized or containerized, from on-premises to full cloud environments. For emergency services, law enforcement and mobile network operators, SS8 also sells location-based services that report where a device is.

On the investigative side, the monitoring center product Intellego XT reconstructs and analyzes voice, data, emails and messages in real time and offers access to hundreds of additional data sources. It maps entities, relationships and movements into link charts, then packages the evidence into playlists and galleries for analysts. A second product, MetaHub, is an AI-enabled data intelligence tool that lets analysts import, search, analyze and structure investigative data and enrich it with third-party sources. Analysts drag and drop evidence such as audio, cell phone data, messages, OSINT, photos, social media and video into a single platform, and MetaHub's OSINT software draws on hundreds of third-party data sources.

SS8 says it has delivered lawful interception and mediation solutions worldwide for over two decades. Its home page cites 6 of the world's largest intelligence agencies, 8 of the 14 largest communications providers and 5 of the world's largest systems integrators.
